coverage.why: Every venue calendar page (songkick.com/venues/<id>/calendar) rendered its full future listing in one server-rendered fetch via schema.org JSON-LD MusicEvent blocks -- no 'load more' or page=N links appeared on any of the 20 venue/sub-venue calendar pages fetched, so nothing was truncated there. The one genuinely paginated surface was the Austin metro-wide calendar (used only for the cityWide count), which showed ~50 events per page and was paged through page=6 to cover the 30-day window. Two venues (Empire, Summit) have technically-live Songkick pages that list zero events in our forward window -- their most recent listed dates are respectively in the past (empire) and 18 months stale (summit); this is recorded as thin/zero coverage rather than a fetch failure, since the pages loaded fine (HTTP 200) and returned real historical JSON-LD, just nothing upcoming.

cityWide.note: Counted unique MusicEvent JSON-LD blocks (deduped by event URL) across the metro page and its page=2..page=6 pagination, filtered to 2026-09-24 through 2026-10-24 inclusive. This count covers ALL Austin-area venues Songkick tracks, not just our 17 -- it is a courtesy/context figure, not a venue-scoped number.

linkBehavior: The venue and metro calendar pages link each event to Songkick's own concert page (songkick.com/concerts/<id>-<slug>), never straight to a ticketer -- that is the 'url' field for every event below. The actual ticket vendor only appears on the individual concert page, rendered server-side as a titled link with a Songkick-owned redirect path, e.g. on https://www.songkick.com/concerts/43130315-ariel-posen-at-antones the buy button carries title="Ticketmaster" and data-ticket-path="/tickets/34219473" (i.e. songkick.com/tickets/34219473, which bounces onward to Ticketmaster -- not verified further). Because that detail lives one fetch per event deeper (~380 events in scope), and the task's courtesy budget/etiquette favors breadth over exhaustive per-event fetches, ticketUrl and ticketer are recorded as null for every event in this file except this one confirmed example pattern. Flagging this as a real gap for the direction page: if per-event ticketer is needed for scoring, that's ~380 additional single-page fetches at ~1/sec (~6-7 minutes of dedicated fetching), not a blocker but a known follow-up.
